title: 首都圈外郭放水路~Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel
focus: 洪水調蓄、跌水豎井與水位控制~Flood storage, drop shafts and level control
summary: 首都圈外郭放水路由入流設施、地下水路、調壓水槽與泵站共同減少洪水影響，官方圖列水路6.3公里。2002年先行運用的是部分3.3公里區間，工程期至2006年。本課以水量、能量及水位基準串接全系統，避免把地下河道誤當道路隧道或將局部算例當完整洪水演算。~The Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel combines intakes, a 6.3 km underground waterway, a pressure-control tank and pumps. Interim use in 2002 covered a 3.3 km portion; construction continued to 2006. This course connects water balance, energy and level datum without treating the facility as a road or a local calculation as full flood routing.

units.anchor: 水體平流時間~Water advection time
units.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間~Underground water routes and travel time
units.mechanism: 首都圈放水路收集多河川入流，教材以水體平流時間辨認路徑，明確區別洪峰波速與控制延遲。地下排水或引水設施的路線先由集水區、入流點、出口水位及坡度定義，不能以交通旅行時間衡量。定速水體的行程可用距離除速度估算，但洪峰波速、蓄水與回水會改變訊號傳遞；各支路必須在共同水位與時間基準下連接。~The channel receives several rivers; use material advection to identify a route while distinguishing flood-wave celerity and control delay. An underground water route is defined by catchments, inflows, outfall level and gradient, not vehicle journey time. Distance divided by velocity estimates constant-speed material travel, while flood-wave celerity, storage and backwater alter signal propagation. Branches must be connected using common level and time references before interpreting arrival or control response.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水路長度=2350 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。t=L/v/60=26.1111 min。僅把水路長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為28.7222 min。邊界：定速水體平流，不是洪峰波速或完整洪水演算；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2350 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=26.1111 min. Increasing only reach length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 28.7222 min. Boundary: Constant-speed water advection, not flood-wave celerity or complete routing. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 對齊各支路和出口的流量水位時序。對齊入口與出口水位流量時間序列，利用允許的示蹤或模型比較平流時間與洪峰時差，保留回水條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Align branch and outlet flow-level histories. Align inlet and outlet level-flow histories; use permitted tracer data or modelling to distinguish material travel from peak lag while preserving backwater conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 用交通速度或單一平流時間預測洪峰都會失去水理意義。把平流時間當洪峰預警時間會忽略波速和支路入流，控制指令可能在假定水體到達之前已失去適用性。~Vehicle speed or one advection time cannot predict flood-peak routing. Using advection time as flood-warning time ignores celerity and side inflows, allowing control assumptions to fail before the assumed arrival.
units.misconception: 水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。~Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
units.practice: 本案「水體平流時間」的交付需回答：對齊各支路和出口的流量水位時序。路線圖同時標示水位基準、支路與控制邊界，所有時間比較註明是物質、波峰或設備延遲，避免混用。~For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the water advection time handover must address the following evidence: Align branch and outlet flow-level histories. Route diagrams show level datum, branches and control boundaries; label each time as material travel, wave propagation or equipment delay.

units.title: 洪水歷線與調蓄餘量~Flood hydrographs and storage reserve
units.mechanism: 調蓄量由入出流歷線積分決定，教材研究下游高水位限制排放時的庫容消耗。調蓄設施以流入減流出的時間積分決定蓄水變化，最大入流量並不單獨決定所需庫容。下游高水位可能限制排水，水位與可用庫容也不是固定比例；需同時檢查初始蓄水、泵站可用性與洪水歷線的時序。~Storage follows integrated inflow minus outflow; examine reserve depletion when downstream high water limits discharge. Storage change is the time integral of inflow minus outflow, so peak inflow alone cannot determine required capacity. High downstream levels can restrict discharge, and level is not always proportional to volume. Initial occupancy, pump availability and hydrograph timing must be assessed together rather than assuming the facility starts empty with unrestricted outflow.
units.model: 原創教學假設：入流=173 m³/s；出流=100 m³/s；時間段=20 min。ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³。僅把入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為108360 m³。邊界：矩形歷線單一時段，真實洪水需逐時積分與水位約束；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: inflow=173 m³/s; outflow=100 m³/s; interval=20 min. ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 108360 m³. Boundary: One rectangular-hydrograph interval; real floods need time integration and level constraints. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 閉合水位庫容和逐時流量帳，保留初始蓄水。將入出流歷線與水位庫容曲線閉合，測試不同初始水位和下游回水，檢查流量資料的時間間隔。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Close level-volume and time-step flow balances with initial storage retained. Close inflow-outflow hydrographs against the level-volume curve, test initial levels and downstream backwater and check sampling intervals. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 假設設施全空且泵始終滿流會低估最高水位。以日平均流量代替短時洪峰會低估最高水位，泵可用卻無法克服下游水頭也會造成錯誤出流假設。~Assuming empty storage and full pumping throughout understates maximum level. Daily mean flow misses short peaks and underestimates maximum level; an available pump may still fail to discharge against the downstream head.
units.misconception: 泵站名目排水量大於平均入流就不需要調蓄容積。~Nominal pumping above mean inflow eliminates the need for storage.
units.practice: 本案「淨入流調蓄量」的交付需回答：閉合水位庫容和逐時流量帳，保留初始蓄水。交付可重算的逐時水量帳，標記起始水位、泵狀態與邊界洪水；控制決策依核准模型和即時量測而非單段算式。~For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the net-inflow storage handover must address the following evidence: Close level-volume and time-step flow balances with initial storage retained. Deliver a reproducible time-step balance with initial level, pump state and boundary flood; control decisions use approved models and observations, not one interval.

units.anchor: 滿管沿程損失~Full-pipe friction loss
units.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界~Conveyance friction and transient boundaries
units.mechanism: 地下水路的摩阻算例限穩態滿管，教材另外辨認自由水面、回水和局部收縮可能改變流況。輸水隧道由上下游能量差驅動，沿程粗糙度、接頭及局部收縮消耗水頭；流速增加使摩阻快速上升。穩態滿管式不能描述水錘、自由水面轉換或氣囊，閘門動作和停機歷程必須另外建立瞬變模型與通氣條件。~The friction example is steady and full-pipe; identify free surfaces, backwater and contractions that can change the flow regime. A conveyance tunnel is driven by upstream and downstream energy levels; roughness, joints and contractions consume head, with friction rising rapidly with velocity. A steady full-pipe equation does not describe water hammer, free-surface transitions or trapped air. Gate movements and shutdown histories require separate transient modelling and explicit ventilation conditions.
units.model: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=2150 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=2.19164 m。僅把流速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2.65189 m。邊界：滿管穩態摩阻，不含水錘與局部損失；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=2150 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=2.19164 m. Increasing only velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2.65189 m. Boundary: Steady full-pipe friction, excluding water hammer and local loss. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以同步水位和流量辨認滿管及非滿管狀態。以同步上下游水位和流量核對能量坡度，分辨入口損失與沿程損失，保留閘門及氣壓狀態。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Use simultaneous levels and flow to distinguish pressurised and free-surface states. Use synchronised levels and flow to check energy gradient, separate entrance from distributed losses and preserve gate and air-pressure states. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 在非滿管時套滿管直徑會得到無物理邊界的損失。把閘門急動後的壓力峰當穩態摩阻，會錯估粗糙度並漏掉瞬變作用；未排出的氣囊也會改變有效斷面。~Using full-pipe geometry in free-surface flow gives an inapplicable loss estimate. Treating post-gate pressure peaks as steady friction biases roughness and misses transients; trapped air also changes effective area.
units.misconception: 只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。~A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「滿管沿程損失」的交付需回答：以同步水位和流量辨認滿管及非滿管狀態。水理交付需包含水位基準、流量、閘門歷程及模型適用狀態；瞬變與通氣由水理設計者另行檢核。~For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the full-pipe friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Use simultaneous levels and flow to distinguish pressurised and free-surface states. Hydraulic handover includes level datum, flow, gate histories and model regimes; specialists independently assess transients and air movement.

units.anchor: 跌水位能通量~Drop potential-energy flux
units.title: 豎井跌水與能量消散~Drop-shaft flow and energy dissipation
units.mechanism: 入流豎井把高程能轉成紊流和壓力，教材算位能通量而不是提升機功率或井壁均壓。水流進入豎井時把高程能轉成速度、紊流與壓力波動，空氣捲入和排氣路徑會改變流況。位能通量只能估計需處理的能量量級，不能由此直接求井壁衝擊壓；進流偏心、淹沒與下游回水需實體或數值水理驗證。~Inlet shafts convert elevation energy into turbulence and pressure; calculate potential-energy flux rather than hoist power or uniform wall pressure. Flow entering a shaft converts elevation energy into velocity, turbulence and fluctuating pressure, while entrainment and ventilation change the regime. Potential-energy flux estimates the scale to be dissipated but cannot directly give wall impact pressure. Eccentric entry, submergence and downstream backwater require physical or numerical hydraulic validation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；流量=20 m³/s；跌水高度=30 m。P=ρgQH/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=5886 kW。僅把流量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6474.6 kW。邊界：位能通量，不是井壁壓力或發電輸出；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; flow=20 m³/s; drop=30 m. P=ρgQH/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=5886 kW. Increasing only flow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6474.6 kW. Boundary: Potential-energy flux, not shaft-wall pressure or electrical output. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 同步量測跌水流量、氣壓和局部壓力脈動。同步量測進出流、水位、井內氣壓和局部壓力脈動，比較淹沒前後工況並檢查取樣頻率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Synchronise drop flow, air pressure and local pressure fluctuations. Synchronise flow, levels, internal air pressure and local pressure fluctuations, comparing submerged and free discharge with adequate sampling frequency. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 平均功率不能直接推出井壁最大衝擊壓。忽略氣路阻塞會低估水位及壓力波動，僅用平均能量可能掩蓋局部衝擊和間歇流。~Mean power cannot directly yield peak wall impact pressure. Ignoring a blocked air path underestimates level and pressure fluctuations; average energy can conceal local impact and intermittent flow.
units.misconception: 跌水位能功率可直接當作豎井壁的均勻壓力。~Drop potential-energy power can be used directly as uniform shaft-wall pressure.
units.practice: 本案「跌水位能通量」的交付需回答：同步量測跌水流量、氣壓和局部壓力脈動。分開交付能量帳、局部壓力和通氣模型，任何流況切換都核對上下游與氣相邊界，不以提升機功率代替水理分析。~For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the drop potential-energy flux handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise drop flow, air pressure and local pressure fluctuations. Deliver energy balance, local-pressure and ventilation models separately; check liquid and air boundaries at regime changes rather than substituting hoist-power calculations.

units.anchor: 頂板荷載傳遞~Roof load transfer
units.title: 地下大廳頂板與支承~Underground hall roofs and supports
units.mechanism: 調壓大廳頂板經柱網傳力，教材條帶彎矩不取代整體框架、柱頭沖切和底板抗浮。大型地下調壓或蓄水大廳的頂板把覆土和自身重量傳到柱牆，再傳給基礎；水壓改變時底板與頂板的作用也不同。單向條帶只是局部彎矩示例，柱網、沖切、框架拘束、基礎變形及施工回填順序都需要整體模型。~The pressure-control hall roof transfers load through columns; strip bending does not replace global, punching or flotation checks. A large underground pressure-control or storage hall transfers overburden and self-weight through its roof into columns, walls and foundations. Changing water pressure affects roof and base differently. A one-way strip illustrates local bending only; column layout, punching, frame restraint, foundation movement and backfilling sequence require a global structural model.
units.model: 原創教學假設：單位長載重=43 kN/m；跨距=3.6 m。M=qL²/8=69.66 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為84.2886 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: line load=43 kN/m; span=3.6 m. M=qL²/8=69.66 kN·m. Increasing only span by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 84.2886 kN·m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded simply supported strip; frame continuity and plate action need separate checks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對柱網、回填、板撓度與柱軸力。核對柱網、板厚及回填紀錄，將柱軸力、板撓度與裂縫位置聯合判讀，不把單一應變點視為整體反應。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check column layout, backfill, slab deflection and column force. Check the column grid, slab thickness and backfill records; interpret column force, deflection and cracking together rather than treating one strain reading as global behaviour. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 頂板均載模型不能用來宣稱整個大廳抗浮穩定。漏掉局部柱頭作用會在平均彎矩不大時仍低估沖切風險，差異沉陷則可能把荷載重新分配到少數支承。~A uniformly loaded roof model cannot establish flotation stability of the hall. Missing column-head effects underestimates punching despite modest mean bending, while differential settlement redistributes load to fewer supports.
units.misconception: 頂板平均彎矩不大就不必檢查柱頭沖切及基礎差異。~Small mean roof bending eliminates column punching and differential foundation checks.
units.practice: 本案「頂板荷載傳遞」的交付需回答：核對柱網、回填、板撓度與柱軸力。將條帶計算標為局部示範，另列整體框架、沖切和抗浮的證據需求，施工與水位階段各自核對荷載。~For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the roof load transfer handover must address the following evidence: Check column layout, backfill, slab deflection and column force. Label the strip calculation as local and list global frame, punching and flotation evidence separately, reconciling loads for each construction and water-level stage.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 地下水位與內部洪水位可分別變動，教材將放空時外壓和充水時淨內壓分開。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~Groundwater and internal flood level vary independently; distinguish external pressure when empty from net internal pressure when filled. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=127 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1245.87 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1370.46 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=127 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1245.87 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1370.46 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將兩側水位換成共同高程和表壓後比較。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Convert both sides to common elevation and gauge pressure before comparison. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只看內水位會漏掉空槽時外部地下水控制作用。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Internal level alone misses groundwater control when the tank is empty. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：將兩側水位換成共同高程和表壓後比較。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Convert both sides to common elevation and gauge pressure before comparison. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.anchor: 襯砌環向壓縮~Lining hoop compression
units.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度~Ring force and joint flexibility
units.mechanism: 圓形地下水路的外壓與內壓方向不同，教材均勻環向量級需要按每個水位階段改變淨壓。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。~External and internal pressures act oppositely on the circular waterway; update net pressure by water-level stage. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.76 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=7.81714 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為8.59886 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.76 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.81714 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 8.59886 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較環形變形與內外水位，而非僅單側壓力。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare ring distortion with both water levels, not one-sided pressure alone. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 忽略放空後外壓回升會低估外壓主導階段。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。~Omitting external-head recovery after draining understates the external-pressure stage. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening.
units.misconception: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。~Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
units.practice: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：比較環形變形與內外水位，而非僅單側壓力。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。~For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Compare ring distortion with both water levels, not one-sided pressure alone. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

units.anchor: 水位零點偏差~Level zero-point bias
units.title: 水位基準與庫容誤差~Level datum and volume uncertainty
units.mechanism: 控制系統把水位轉成剩餘庫容，教材研究共同零點偏移如何讓多感測器一致卻錯估餘量。調蓄控制依賴水位訊號，但壓力式水位計還受氣壓、密度與安裝高程影響。水位誤差乘局部面積可估計一階庫容偏差；若斷面變寬或分艙逐次連通，必須使用完整水位庫容曲線，而非假設全程固定面積。~Controls convert level to reserve volume; examine a shared zero bias that makes sensors agree while misestimating capacity. Storage control depends on level signals, but pressure-based sensors are affected by air pressure, density and installation elevation. Level error times local area estimates first-order volume bias. Widening sections and sequentially connected compartments require the full level-volume relation rather than a constant area across the operating range.
units.model: 原創教學假設：局部平面面積=3000 m²；水位零點偏移=0.025 m。ΔV=AΔh=75 m³。僅把水位零點偏移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為82.5 m³。邊界：局部等面積一階庫容誤差，變寬及分艙另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: local plan area=3000 m²; level zero offset=0.025 m. ΔV=AΔh=75 m³. Increasing only level zero offset by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 82.5 m³. Boundary: First-order constant-area volume bias; varying width and compartments are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以獨立水準和人工水尺核對零點及庫容表。用獨立水準點和人工水尺覆核感測器零點，逐一核對氣壓補償與不同水位的庫容曲線。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check zero and volume tables against independent levelling and a staff gauge. Check sensor zero against independent benchmarks and a staff gauge, verifying air-pressure compensation and the volume relation at several levels. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 多支同基準感測器不能互相排除共同高程錯誤。多支感測器共用錯誤高程可互相比對一致，卻一致高估剩餘庫容，使控制系統遲判水位上升。~Sensors sharing one reference cannot eliminate a common elevation error by agreement. Several sensors sharing a wrong datum can agree while overestimating remaining volume and delaying recognition of rising water.
units.misconception: 多支水位計讀值相同就能排除共同零點偏差。~Matching readings from multiple sensors exclude a shared zero-point bias.
units.practice: 本案「水位零點偏差」的交付需回答：以獨立水準和人工水尺核對零點及庫容表。庫容表與水位計使用同一經覆核的高程版本，感測器更換後重驗轉換和警報邏輯，保留原始讀值。~For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the level zero-point bias handover must address the following evidence: Check zero and volume tables against independent levelling and a staff gauge. Use one checked datum revision for volume tables and sensors; after replacement verify conversions and alarm logic while preserving raw readings.

units.title: 設備備援與共同失效~Equipment redundancy and common failure
units.mechanism: 防洪泵組可用性還取決於供電、出口水頭和共用設備，教材獨立並聯式只作下限模型。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。~Flood-pump availability also depends on power, discharge head and shared assets; the independent-parallel equation is only a restricted model. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities.
units.model: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.033 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.001089 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00131769 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.033 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.001089 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00131769 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 追查每泵供電、閘門和共同出水路徑。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace each pump feed, gate and shared discharge route. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 兩泵正常仍可能因同一高下游水位無法達名目出流。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。~Two healthy pumps may fail to achieve rated flow against the same high tailwater. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability.
units.misconception: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。~Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
units.practice: 本案「系統不可用率」的交付需回答：追查每泵供電、閘門和共同出水路徑。維修計畫附當日可用配置與剩餘備援，任何共同資源更動同步更新故障樹，切換試驗由設備及營運團隊共同見證。~For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Trace each pump feed, gate and shared discharge route. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 洪水事件紀錄需連接雨量、閘門、水位和泵站狀態，教材以事件時間軸檢查資料完整與可追溯性。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Flood records must link rainfall, gates, levels and pump state; use an event timeline to check completeness and traceability. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=123 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.9919 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.6911 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=123 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.9919 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.6911 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 從一次水位峰回查所有感測器時間與校正版本。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace one level peak through sensor timestamps and calibration revisions. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 時鐘錯位會把泵啟動先後顛倒，造成錯誤控制評估。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~Clock offsets reverse apparent pump timing and distort control evaluation. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：從一次水位峰回查所有感測器時間與校正版本。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace one level peak through sensor timestamps and calibration revisions. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「洪水歷線與調蓄餘量」，再獨立計算「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」。原創教學假設：入流=173 m³/s；出流=100 m³/s；時間段=20 min。ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³。僅把入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為108360 m³。邊界：矩形歷線單一時段，真實洪水需逐時積分與水位約束；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=127 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1245.87 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1370.46 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate flood hydrographs and storage reserve, then independently calculate piezometric head and lining pressure. Original teaching assumptions: inflow=173 m³/s; outflow=100 m³/s; interval=20 min. ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 108360 m³. Boundary: One rectangular-hydrograph interval; real floods need time integration and level constraints. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=127 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1245.87 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1370.46 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2002 年公開記錄：第3立坑至泵站3.3公里區間於6月先行運用。首都圈外郭放水路由入流設施、地下水路、調壓水槽與泵站共同減少洪水影響，官方圖列水路6.3公里。2002年先行運用的是部分3.3公里區間，工程期至2006年。本課以水量、能量及水位基準串接全系統，避免把地下河道誤當道路隧道或將局部算例當完整洪水演算。本課把「洪水調蓄、跌水豎井與水位控制」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2002: The 3.3 km reach from shaft 3 to the pumping station begins interim use in June. The Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel combines intakes, a 6.3 km underground waterway, a pressure-control tank and pumps. Interim use in 2002 covered a 3.3 km portion; construction continued to 2006. This course connects water balance, energy and level datum without treating the facility as a road or a local calculation as full flood routing. The course treats flood storage, drop shafts and level control as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 6.3 km underground waterway，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 6.3 km underground waterway; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2002 年事件：第3立坑至泵站3.3公里區間於6月先行運用。~2002 event: The 3.3 km reach from shaft 3 to the pumping station begins interim use in June.

教學「水體平流時間」：水路長度=2350 m，其餘輸入依單元，結果=26.1111 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching water advection time: reach length=2350 m, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 26.1111 min; not measured or accepted project data.
教學「淨入流調蓄量」：入流=173 m³/s，其餘輸入依單元，結果=87600 m³；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching net-inflow storage: inflow=173 m³/s, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 87600 m³; not measured or accepted project data.
教學「頂板荷載傳遞」：單位長載重=43 kN/m，其餘輸入依單元，結果=69.66 kN·m；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching roof load transfer: line load=43 kN/m, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 69.66 kN·m; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「測壓水頭」：水密度=1000 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=1245.87 kPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching piezometric head: water density=1000 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 1245.87 kPa; not measured or accepted project data.
